notes.title: PBR goes brrrr Update (v0.7.0)
notes.content:
Major changes in this one, not enough for a major update (aka game release)
The day is getting closer and closer!
Not sure if it will be... soon though (sadly).

Changelog
- Major material changes
- Changed some decals so they actually look good
- Added debris
- Replaced one animatronic, welcome Buster into this game now!
- Added basic save system
CAUTION: New Game will override all previous data (which is probably nothing if you haven't played this update yet)!
- New PBR materials
- New AI controller
- Minor bug fixes
- Changed 6AM text
- Added shift number functionality so that it actually changes
- (hopefully) Fixed animatronic animations
- Added the rest of the Story Mode button functionality
- Fixed something that caused minor lag
- Added framing to the Office window
- Added extra lights to some places in the building

Wow, that's the biggest changelog yet!

notes.title: The Steam Is Coming Out Update (v0.6.0 part 2)
notes.content:
So we meet again
I haven't quite updated JHRI in a few weeks, well guess what now you got one!

Changelog
- Added cameras functionality
- Added occasional room lights
- Added voice acting in the Helper Tape for Shift 1
- Added a camera panel
- Tweaked AI so there's more delay before AI starts
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: The Great Collision Patch (v0.5.2)

A standard update, we fixed a few things.

Changelog

- Fixed animatronic attack not working
- Changed battery font
- Added percentage to the battery text
- Aligned the battery text properly

notes.title: THE OFFICIAL EARLY ACCESS JHRI RELEASE!
notes.content:
It's here faster than I thought
Well, the day is here! JHRI is now officially out!
Although it does require a bit more changes before the full version.

Help me out by either replying to this, or posting a (proper) review.

We will be trying to roll out updates monthly, in some cases weekly.

And no I'm not going to post all the changelogs here.

(unreal engine you literally took 2-3 hours to build the freaking game it's only 700 mb)
